schedule_risks.detail: FY2027 continuing resolution H.R. 6500 / P.L. 119-103 (signed 2026-09-02) funds the government through 2026-12-11. No lapse on 2026-10-01. A lapse from 2026-12-12 could delay BLS/Census/BEA releases on or after that date (PPI 12-15, Retail Sales 12-16, GDP/PCE 12-23). None of the official schedule pages showed shutdown notices on 2026-09-28.
